theme_strategy: Light theme strongly preferred (nature, home, cozy, pastel). Implement a toggle if absolutely necessary, but default to light mode to ensure the 'warm and cozy' family-friendly vibe.

headings.styles: Rounded, approachable, human. Use 'tracking-tight' for H1-H2. Do not use Inter or generic sans. If Nunito is unavailable, use 'Quicksand' or 'Fredoka'.
headings.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black text-foreground tracking-tighter

body.styles: Highly readable, warm, clean. text-base for regular text, text-sm for labels.

colors.palette_archetype: ORGANIC & EARTHY mixed with PASTEL & SOFT (Trust, Calm, Approachability)
rules: NO transparent backgrounds on surfaces with content over them.
Use #E07A5F (Terracotta) for primary actions and important alerts.
Use #81B29A (Sage) for success states, money/budgets, and completed chores.
Use #F2CC8F (Soft Sun Yellow) for AI catchup highlights and playful accents.
Tint greys with a warm orange/brown hue, never use pure #000000 or #808080.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Soft, diffuse shadows. shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)] for cards to feel elevated but not stark.
visual_enhancers.border_radius: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) for buttons, large rounded corners (rounded-3xl or rounded-2xl) for cards and modules. Avoid sharp edges to maintain the 'family-friendly' vibe.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use a subtle 1px border on cards with border-border to provide crispness alongside the soft shadows.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle grain overlays can be used on the AI catch-up card to make it feel special.

layouts_and_grids.dashboard_grid: MODE B: High Density Grid but with breathing room. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. gap-6 or gap-8.
layouts_and_grids.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy: Use p-6 or p-8 inside cards. Use gap-8 between major sections.
layouts_and_grids.alignment: Mobile-First. Left-align text for readability, center-align empty states or AI conversational prompts.

modules_and_components.navigation: Sidebar or top nav. If sidebar, keep it clean with rounded pill-shaped active states.
modules_and_components.ai_catchup: Prominent top row widget. col-span-full. Soft yellow or gradient background (warm tones), conversational tone. No login needed.
modules_and_components.calendar_appointments: col-span-2. Use Shadcn calendar heavily customized to remove the 'Vercel' look (make it rounded, warm colors).
modules_and_components.chores_rotation: List view. Avatars for partners. Strikethrough animations on completion.
modules_and_components.kids_homework: Card with progress bars. Friendly icons.
modules_and_components.pet_care: Dog walking log, vaccines. Include the dog image here.
modules_and_components.groceries: Checklist style. Add to list inline. Left-aligned.
modules_and_components.budget: Simple, non-intimidating charts. Use Shadcn charts with the secondary (sage green) color.

motion.hover: Slight lift (-translate-y-1) and subtle shadow increase (shadow-lg) for interactive cards.
motion.interactions: Hover states MUST explicitly change text color or background. Active states scale down slightly (scale-95).
motion.transitions: Use specific transitions: transition-transform duration-200 ease-out, transition-colors duration-200. NO transition-all.
motion.lists: Staggered entrance animations for chores and groceries lists.

icons_and_assets.icon_library: lucide-react (default). Use rounded variants if possible, or keep stroke width thick (2px or 2.5px) for a friendlier look.

ai_catchup_bg.description: Warm living room with fireplace, used as a very low opacity background for the AI catchup section to feel 'homely'.

family_avatar_1.description: Family portrait for household settings or partner chore rotation.

pet_dog.description: Playful dog portrait for the dog appointments and care module.

groceries.description: Woman selecting fresh produce, can be used in the empty state of the groceries module.

component_instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize creating custom UI using raw HTML+Tailwind for high-level layouts, but USE Shadcn UI for complex interactives (Calendar, Checkbox, Select, Dialog).
Customize Shadcn components: increase border-radius (e.g., rounded-2xl for cards, rounded-full for buttons), use the defined warm color palette, and soften the borders.
Data structure: Mock the data thoroughly for the family (2 partners, kids, dog), prepopulate tasks, chores, and budgets to make the dashboard look active and 'lived-in'.
AI Catchup: Create a specialized card at the top that summarizes the week (e.g., 'Good morning! Dog has a vet appointment tomorrow, and you are under budget this week.').
Use 'sonner' for toast notifications when checking off chores or adding groceries.
NO placeholder text for logos or missing images. Use the provided image URLs.
Every interactive element MUST have a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='chore-checkbox', data-testid='add-grocery-btn').
Do not center-align the app container. Remove .App { text-align: center; } if present in App.css.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text, especially white text on primary buttons or Terracotta text on warm backgrounds, passes APCA/WCAG AA minimums.
accessibility.focus: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/50 focus:outline-none for all inputs and buttons.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. This disrupts natural reading flow.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons. Use lucide-react icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
